svg.aria-label: Layers and import direction: cmd/apranik imports config, config imports core, core's registry names the modules, modules may import shared helper packages, and everything implements or uses spec. Every layer imports spec directly; spec imports nothing from the project. Modules also use config/types for shared JSON values.
